rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for a demon and can also describe a person regarded as utterly evil.

example.english: That murderer is a fiend who will not even spare children.
example.traditional: 嗰個兇手簡直係魔鬼，連細路都唔放過。
example.jyutping: go2 go3 hung1 sau2 gaan2 zik6 hai6 mo1 gwai2 lin4 sai3 lou6 dou1 m4 fong3 gwo3

rows.note: Use this for an addict, especially someone addicted to drugs.

example.english: The police arrested a drug fiend.
example.traditional: 警方拘捕咗一名吸毒嘅癮君子。
example.jyutping: ging2 fong1 keoi1 bou6 zo2 jat1 ming4 kap1 duk6 ge3 jan5 gwan1 zi2

rows.note: Use this for a fanatic or obsessive fan, usually after the thing the person is devoted to.

example.english: He is a football fiend who watches every match.
example.traditional: 佢係個足球迷，場場波都追住睇。
example.jyutping: keoi5 hai6 go3 zuk1 kau4 mai4 coeng4 coeng4 bo1 dou1 zeoi1 zyu6 tai2
